fusions.name: Spellbitten
fusions.desc: Spits a bolt of arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance of [Spell Impetus] for 6 seconds, lowering every resistance.

fusions.name: Yawning Maw
fusions.desc: Opens the jaws on a wide cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 26 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Silted Ward
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your arcane resistance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Thickened Husk
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a shield worth 6% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
